substeps.caption: A polished 1.25 in mount goes onto the motorized XY stage (50 x 50 mm travel).
The motorized turret swings the Vickers indenter over it; the force motor presses: HV0.5, 4.9 N.
The 50x objective comes back. The 3 MP camera images the indent; AVPAK measures both diagonals.
A series across the coupon: the stage steps (0.5 mm apart; drawn 3 mm), and each indent is made and read the same way, unattended.
315 x 671 x 595 mm and 43 kg: on a tray, with 260 mm to spare under the opening. HM-220: 0.05 gf to 2 kgf, enough for HV0.5 on Al alloys.
